answer: Live cross-examination: each epoch a random peer sends an agent a timed follow-up question about its own earlier answer, due within minutes. A farm of a thousand fake agents can't reuse one cheap template; it must hold a thousand coherent, concurrent conversations, so cost grows linearly with identities. Like water carving karst, the pressure is slow but relentless: reward nectar flows only to identities that pass, and a failed check leaves just an ember of reputation to rebuild.
